# Aurelien

[Aurane](Aurane.md) > [Regane](Regane.md)

Moon. Aurane VII - Moon 17.

*Game data as of 10 February 305.*

<!-- Generated by build_wiki.py. Edit the lore file, not this page. -->

## Lore

A founder's name from House [Varenne](../../Houses/Varenne.md), on the largest of the six house moons, which run in founding order by size. Varenne would insist on that order, and Dunmere having the smallest suits its grievance. A moon of [Regane](Regane.md). These are old astronomers' names from before the Ledger, so no marks were awarded.
